content: Root cause: The bug in the previous implementation stemmed from a change associated with the handling of resource updates in the "add hosts" API. Specifically, the predicate evaluation, which was removed in an earlier fix for a different bug (BUG-28737), inadvertently caused a regression in the functionality of the "add hosts" API. This omission meant that the update requests were not correctly evaluated against existing resources, leading to potential inconsistencies in the application state during host additions. Additionally, related to Kerberos configurations, the absence of logic to add the Kerberos client component to host groups when Kerberos was enabled resulted in further incomplete setup during host additions. The patch restored the necessary evaluations and added the Kerberos client logic, ensuring both the "add hosts" functionality and Kerberos support were properly implemented.
